title: SETTINGS READS AS ONE LAYOUT
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus still look bad, take pictures and make it look like a triple A game. The picture review of Settings found the list centred under a title and tabs on the left, so the page read as two layouts with a wide empty strip, the row names mixed small letters (Edit the words) with capitals (LIGHTING), THE RAID heading was faint, and the values were plain boxes with nothing to say they step through options. The list now starts on the left under the tabs, every row name is drawn in the same capitals (the words themselves are unchanged), the section headings are bright with an amber mark, and each value that steps through options shows arrows either side of it.
now: Settings lines up on the left, every row name is in the same capitals, and the values show stepper arrows.
